QUOTE: In the default configuration it expands to `private_##member`, so `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` compiles to `ctx->private_state`. ... When it is defined, the wrapper expands to the plain member name.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_<member> and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS expands to the plain member name.
